title.en: Reply to a vague vendor quote

user_goal.ko: 빠진 상업 조건을 열거한 전문적인 확인 이메일
user_goal.en: a professional clarification email listing the missing commercial facts

task.expected_artifact: a professional clarification email listing the missing commercial facts

messages.content:
다음 내용의 메시지 범위를 먼저 잡아줘: 모호한 공급업체 견적에 답하기
맥락: 견적에는 총액만 있고 수량, 배송 조건, 세금 처리, 유효 기간이 없다.
산출물: 빠진 상업 조건을 열거한 전문적인 확인 이메일
견적을 수락하거나 세금·배송 조건을 추정하지 않는다.
빠르게 부탁: 모호한 공급업체 견적에 답하기 — 메모는 견적에는 총액만 있고 수량, 배송 조건, 세금 처리, 유효 기간이 없어., 결과는 빠진 상업 조건을 열거한 전문적인 체크 이메일. 없는 정보는 추정하지 말고 표시해줘
추가로, 결정에 중요한 정보가 빠졌으면 만들지 말고 질문하거나 가정을 표시해줘.

Help frame a message about a reply to a vague vendor quote. Context: The quote has a total price but no quantities, delivery terms, tax treatment, or validity period. Deliver: a professional clarification email listing the missing commercial facts. Do not accept the quote or infer tax and delivery terms.

quick one: a reply to a vague vendor quote — I’ve got The quote has a total price, but no quantities, delivery terms, tax treatment, or validity period.; can you give me a professional clarification email listing the missing commercial facts? no invented details pls
One more thing: if a decision-critical detail is missing, ask or state the assumption instead of inventing it.

invariants: Preserve the stated facts and constraints for a reply to a vague vendor quote.
Do not accept the quote or infer tax and delivery terms.
Distinguish confirmed information, assumptions, and missing evidence.
Do not claim an external action, source check, or professional determination that did not occur.
failure_signals: The response changes or omits a decision-critical fact about a reply to a vague vendor quote.
Do not accept the quote or infer tax and delivery terms.
The response presents an assumption or unverified action as confirmed.
